Title: The Thousand and First [ALPHA]
Description:
Build a kingdom in the salt, one settlement at a time.

[b]Alpha playtest build.[/b] Expect bugs, missing content and rough edges. Built for Caves of Qud v1.0.5 (core 2.0.211.51). This listing stays Alpha; Beta and Release will be separate Workshop items.

Found a faction through a water rite and build it into a kingdom: settlements, districts, buildings, food, water, trade and threats, all inside a normal Qud run, and optionally a legacy across worlds.

[b]What you can do[/b]
- Found a faction through a water rite and plant your first settlement
- Zone plots across ten typed categories in S, M, L and XL sizes
- Raise buildings tiered by style, creed, materials and technology
- Grow food, manage water and trade between your cities
- Answer threats as the kingdom grows
- Start your next character as a citizen of the kingdom you built
- Leave a legacy across worlds, if you choose

[b]Saves[/b]
Back up your saves before testing. Save data is versioned and migrated between updates. If an update ever cannot read a save, the mod quarantines it and tells you instead of corrupting it.

[b]Bugs and feedback[/b]
https://github.com/AussieWarGod/thousand-and-first/issues

[b]Contribute[/b]
Open source under MIT: https://github.com/AussieWarGod/thousand-and-first
Artists and builders welcome. If you enjoy drawing Qud-style tiles or laying out settlements, every building has a design dossier to work from, and submissions go through the repo. A paid art and design pass over the whole catalogue is planned for Beta.
Modders can reuse the in-game scenario test framework for their own additions.
